value: Copperline Community League, amateur football, two divisions of four clubs, autumn season 2026.
Matches are played as two halves of 40 minutes with rolling substitutions.
ASH Ashquill Rovers, MIL Millcress Athletic, NOR Norrowby United, QUA Quarrimoor Town (premier). RIV Rivelmere Wanderers, TAN Tanswold Park, BRK Brackenwhist FC, LOW Lowfennel Albion (championship).
The league office answers captains Monday to Thursday, 18:00 to 21:00.
A matchday squad is at most 16 players.
Five yellow cards in a season earn a one-match ban.
A red card carries a ban of at least two matches.
Weather postponement calls are made by 10:00 on match day.
Ashquill Rovers prefer home fixtures at Harbour Park on Saturdays.
Idris Calloway is on three yellow cards and was reminded about the five-card ban.
Dara Whitlock is one yellow card away from a ban.
Nell Tarrant reached five yellow cards and serves a one-match ban next fixture.
Lena Harrowgate was named championship player of the month for September.
Harbour Park has a 3G artificial pitch and a small car park behind the east stand.
Quarry Lane is a natural grass pitch and drains slowly after heavy rain.
Old Mill Ground is a natural grass pitch with street parking only.
Ridge Meadow is a hybrid grass pitch with a large car park.
The mid-season break runs from 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-22.
The Copperline Cup final is on 2026-12-19 at Harbour Park.
All kick-off times are local time.
The help desk reports results and rules but does not decide disciplinary cases.
